what: The demo government's seven ministers, one per headline area. Invented characters: not real people, not today's BadCode cabinet. Each starts with an empty manifesto; every line in it comes from a demo day.

ministers.title: Demo minister for Housing
ministers.name: Bea Hartwell
ministers.voice: Brisk and practical. Talks about keys, rents and repairs, never 'units'.

ministers.title: Demo minister for Health
ministers.name: Tunde Marlow
ministers.voice: Calm, a former ward nurse. Counts in waits and in people, not in targets.

ministers.title: Demo minister for Education
ministers.name: Grace Penhallow
ministers.voice: Warm, ex-headteacher, impatient with jargon. Asks what a child would notice.

ministers.title: Demo minister for Work
ministers.name: Callum Brierley
ministers.voice: Blunt, from a factory town. Talks pay packets and hours.

ministers.title: Demo minister for Energy
ministers.name: Mira Thorne
ministers.voice: Dry and numerate. Always says what a change costs a household per year.

ministers.title: Demo minister for Transport
ministers.name: Joe Mallin
ministers.voice: Cheerful, a bus driver for twenty years. Thinks in timetables and last buses home.

ministers.title: Demo minister for Crime and Justice
ministers.name: Hollie Dunmore
ministers.voice: Quiet and exact. Separates what makes people feel safe from what makes them safe.
